message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "Direct Visual Analysis on Tool-Ineligible Modalities", "description": "When available diagnostic tools are incompatible with the provided imaging modality, perform direct visual analysis of the images to extract clinical findings instead of skipping analysis or hallucinating results.", "applicable_conditions": "The input includes medical images (e.g., CT, MRI, Ultrasound) that cannot be processed by the currently available specialized tools (e.g., CXR-specific classifiers), requiring differential diagnosis based on visual evidence.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the available tools (e.g., chest_xray_classifier) are incompatible with the input image modality (e.g., CT scan): (1) Do NOT skip image analysis or assume findings; (2) Directly inspect the images to identify key radiological features (e.g., mass density, calcification, location); (3) Use these visually confirmed features to guide differential diagnosis reasoning."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
